title.meaning: Run label; no change to chemistry.

smiles.meaning: Initial molecular connectivity; explicit hydrogens are generated in the recorded atom order.

mult.meaning: Doublet parent; fragment multiplicities are assigned separately.

barrier_threshold.meaning: Search cutoff in kcal/mol. 1000 keeps high candidate barriers available; it does not certify their stationary points or enlarge the MESS energy grid.

high_level.meaning: Refine accepted structures at the L2 profile.

rotor_scan.meaning: Build hindered-rotor potentials where chemically applicable.

theory_preset.meaning: L1 Gaussian B3LYP-D3(BJ)/cc-pVDZ; L2 Gaussian B2PLYP-D3(BJ)/cc-pVTZ. Both use Sella optimization and native harmonic Hessians; open-shell forms follow multiplicity.

composite_method.meaning: Automatic CBH/ATcT plus ANL1-F12 component workflow for accepted species and stationary points; not a CASPT2 kinetic sampling method.

anl_f12_augmented.meaning: Use fully augmented QZ-F12/5Z-F12 reference bases for ANL1-F12 thermochemistry. This is distinct from the VRC aDZ/aTZ pair.

vrc_tst_accuracy_preset.meaning: CASPT2-only VRC defaults; explicit values below override the preset. It does not select a chemical active space automatically.

vrc_tst_sample_basis.meaning: aDZ-F12 orbital basis for orientation sampling.

vrc_tst_active_space.meaning: Selected electron/orbital counts; per-bond surface overrides bind the actual checkpoint. See nested controls below.

rotdpy_run.meaning: Submit and complete RotdPy sampling rather than only writing input.

rotdpy_validation_profile.meaning: Require production correction/surface/convergence records before accepting flux.

rotdpy_mess_mode.meaning: Use validated Rotd state counts in MESS; do not silently fall back to PST for a failed VRC calculation.

run_messpf.meaning: Execute MESSPF and parse standalone species partition functions for thermochemistry.

me.meaning: Build the MESS network. PES workers use me=2 for intermediate files; the PES controller assembles the final network.

run_me.meaning: Execute MESS after accepted ANL/thermochemistry/VRC handoff.

epsilon.meaning: Lennard-Jones well depth of the reacting system, in epsilon_unit. These example transport estimates are provisional, not fitted kinetic evidence.

epsilon_unit.meaning: Input energy unit; resolved worker JSON records cm-1 after conversion to avoid converting twice.

sigma.meaning: Lennard-Jones collision diameter in angstrom. Provisional transport estimate; pressure-dependent rates depend on this choice.

queue_name.meaning: Blodgett partition; the runtime discovers its actual time limit.

ppn.meaning: Eight requested processor slots for ordinary QC jobs.

queue_job_limit.meaning: At most ten simultaneous allocations within a KinBot worker calculation tree.

electronic_state_models.meaning: General species-level electronic data: sulfur fine structure for MESS/PF and its explicit ANL centroid correction; CH3S spatial degeneracy for state planning. Not an automatic VRC SOC potential.

homolytic_bonds.meaning: Only the initial-well C-S bond, or C-S and S-S bonds, are requested for hom_sci. Atom indices here are ZERO based. The initial alias was added on this branch.

vrc_tst_scan_shift.meaning: Real CASPT2 level shift in hartree for relaxed scans: 0.1.

vrc_tst_scan_ipea.meaning: CASPT2 IPEA shift in hartree for relaxed scans: 0.25.

vrc_tst_spin_splitting.meaning: Ground high-spin CC anchor plus target-minus-reference CASPT2 gaps, extrapolated aDZ/aTZ with exponent 3.7. See nested controls.

vrc_tst_scan_method.meaning: Method method for constrained relaxed geometries. Explicit CAS(5,4) or CAS(7,5); per-channel selection remains authoritative.

vrc_tst_scan_basis.meaning: aTZ-F12 basis for constrained relaxed scans.

vrc_tst_scan_gradient.meaning: Numerical derivatives of the declared target CASPT2-F12 root. The composite spin-gap-corrected energy is not differentiated.

vrc_tst_sample_method.meaning: Orientation-sampling method method, replaced by CAS(5,4) or CAS(7,5).

vrc_tst_high_method.meaning: Trusted MR method method; the spin_splitting model uses its explicit gap levels and CC anchor.

vrc_tst_high_basis.meaning: Two-basis MR estimate, aDZ-F12 and aTZ-F12.

vrc_tst_high_extrapolation_power.meaning: 3.7 in X^(-p) extrapolation. A user-requested two-basis estimate, not a demonstrated error bar for F12 spin gaps.

vrc_tst_correction_model.meaning: Combine the spin-gap-corrected relaxed cut with the frozen-fragment sampling cut, including the configured-level geometry-relaxation contribution.

single_point_ppn.meaning: Eight processor slots for ordinary single-point work.

vrc_tst_max_nodes.meaning: VRC allocation ceiling; admission is shared with concurrent automatic CBH/ANL work.

vrc_tst_min_stack_mw.meaning: Minimum Molpro stack per rank, in million 8-byte words; the dispatcher checks total memory including overhead.

rotdpy_max_jobs.meaning: Maximum concurrent Rotd jobs for this PES; ten, not an additional ten concurrent with its unfinished earlier branches.

rotdPy_mem.meaning: Molpro sampling stack in million words per rank.

rotdpy_processors.meaning: Eight MPI processors per sampling allocation.

slurm_exclude_nodes.meaning: The eleven user-identified unusable nodes. The list is explicit site data, never hardcoded in general chemistry code.

rotdpy_exclusive.meaning: Request exclusive Slurm nodes for Rotd jobs.

vrc_tst_memory_mb.meaning: 104000 MB total requested memory per VRC allocation, covering all rank stacks and overhead.

simultaneous_kinbot.meaning: One PES worker at a time, so ten jobs per worker remains ten per PES rather than multiplying across wells.

rotdpy_flux_parameters.meaning: RotdPy Monte Carlo 1 percent statistical target with explicit finite minimum/maximum sampling counts; convergence must be verified.

vrc_tst_surface_model.meaning: Inline channels, physical surfaces, per-bond CAS counts and basis-specific orbital indices/checkpoints, states, weights and solver controls. No second configuration file.

sella_fmax.meaning: Final L1/L2 maximum force norm 0.0001 eV/angstrom, followed by native Hessian validation. Gaussian Opt keywords do not control Sella.

anl_geometry_fmax.meaning: Final automatic L3 geometry maximum force norm 0.0001 eV/angstrom; configurable for every molecule.

anl_scf_convergence.meaning: SCF 1e-10 control: Gaussian density Conver=10; Molpro/CFOUR/MRCC backend-mapped threshold.

anl_cc_convergence.meaning: Coupled-cluster convergence 1e-8, mapped to each ANL backend.

minimum_recovery_attempts.meaning: At most two native-Hessian imaginary-mode descent/reoptimization attempts for Gaussian L1/L2 minima; never transition states.

minimum_recovery_displacement.meaning: Full Cartesian norm 0.02 angstrom on first L1/L2 recovery, 0.04 on second; both signs evaluated independently.

imagfreq_threshold.meaning: Existing L1/L2 frequency rejection threshold 50 cm^-1. This is not loosened to accept a failed minimum.

anl_minimum_recovery.meaning: ANL unconstrained minimum curvature validation before downstream energies: two retries, 0.02 angstrom descent, central force differences at 0.01 angstrom, projected vibrational threshold 1 cm^-1. Native harmonic validation remains independent; extra computational cost is explicit.
